records.title: The Mercy Sloane Chronicles: Chapter 25
records.byline: By Eliza Blue A work of serialized fiction, special to the Pioneer
records.description: As Sophia’s laughter bounced around the creek like an otherworldly acrobat, Mercy thought of Ardath talking about the prairie playing tricks with light and sound. “She’s a sneaky one, alright,” Ardath had said with a rough chuckle. “Doesn’t give up her secrets easily. She’ll make you earn them — that’s for certain. See those buttes?” Ardath had pointed west to the sheer, white rocks some twenty miles away. ‘Some days I swear they are close enough to walk to before breakfast. Others I can’t see them at all.” She paused. “I’ll think I hear Harold barking by the barn, and I’ll find him down in the trees. The prairie is a tough old gal; she makes her own canyons with wind and clouds and then leaves us humans listening for the echoes.”
